description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing dependencies, parameter analysis, and request handling in FastAPI, including dependency resolution, parameter extraction, and request body processing.

classes.name: ParamDetails
classes.description: Data class holding parameter analysis results, including type annotation, dependencies, and associated model field.

classes.name: SolvedDependency
classes.description: Data class representing the result of dependency resolution, including values, errors, response, background tasks, and cache.

methods.name: ensure_multipart_is_installed
methods.description: Checks if 'python-multipart' is installed and correctly configured, raises RuntimeError if not.

methods.name: get_parameterless_sub_dependant
methods.description: Creates a Dependant for a parameterless dependency, considering OAuth scopes if applicable.

methods.name: get_flat_dependant
methods.description: Flattens nested dependencies into a single Dependant, optionally skipping repeats.

methods.name: _get_flat_fields_from_params
methods.description: Extracts model fields from a list, expanding if a single BaseModel is present.

methods.name: get_flat_params
methods.description: Returns flattened list of model fields from a Dependant's dependencies.

methods.name: _get_signature
methods.description: Retrieves the signature of a callable, handling eval_str and Python version differences.

methods.name: get_typed_signature
methods.description: Returns a signature with annotated parameters, evaluating forward references.

methods.name: get_typed_annotation
methods.description: Evaluates and returns a possibly string-based annotation, handling ForwardRef.

methods.name: get_typed_return_annotation
methods.description: Retrieves and evaluates the return annotation of a callable.

methods.name: get_stream_item_type
methods.description: Determines the item type of a stream annotation, if applicable.

methods.name: get_dependant
methods.description: Constructs a Dependant object for a given path and callable, analyzing parameters for dependencies.

methods.name: add_non_field_param_to_dependency
methods.description: Assigns special parameters (Request, WebSocket, etc.) to a Dependant based on type.

methods.name: analyze_param
methods.description: Analyzes a parameter's annotation, default, and other info to determine its dependency or model field.

methods.name: add_param_to_fields
methods.description: Adds a ModelField to the appropriate list in a Dependant based on its 'in' parameter.

methods.name: _solve_generator
methods.description: Resolves generator dependencies, entering async or sync context managers.

methods.name: solve_dependencies
methods.description: Resolves all dependencies for a given Dependant, including nested dependencies, request data, and context management.

methods.name: _validate_value_with_model_field
methods.description: Validates a value against a Pydantic ModelField, returning validated value and errors.

methods.name: _is_json_field
methods.description: Checks if a ModelField is of type Json.

methods.name: _get_multidict_value
methods.description: Extracts a value from a MultiDict or similar, considering sequences and defaults.

methods.name: request_params_to_args
methods.description: Converts request parameters (query, headers, cookies) into a dict of arguments for dependency functions.

methods.name: is_union_of_base_models
methods.description: Checks if a field type is a Union of only BaseModel subclasses.

methods.name: _should_embed_body_fields
methods.description: Determines if body fields should be embedded based on their configuration.

methods.name: _extract_form_body
methods.description: Extracts form data into a dict, reading files asynchronously if needed.

methods.name: request_body_to_args
methods.description: Converts request body data into dependency arguments, handling embedded models and validation.

methods.name: get_body_field
methods.description: Creates a ModelField representing the request body, possibly combining multiple fields.

methods.name: get_validation_alias
methods.description: Returns the alias used for validation, falling back to the field's alias.
